valueScenarios.label: Where This Brand Creates the Most Value

cards.title: Design-Led Independent Hotel
cards.body: Culturally distinctive, design-forward independent hotels seeking curated global recognition—Design Hotels fits when owners want to preserve local identity, architecture, and storytelling while accessing Marriott Bonvoy distribution and collection credibility.

cards.title: Conversion With Design Integrity
cards.body: Repositioned boutique or lifestyle assets where design narrative and guest experience authenticity are central—owners evaluate curation standards, owner control, and affiliation value without a standardized franchise prototype.

cards.title: Urban Cultural Destination
cards.body: Urban hotels anchored in neighborhood culture, art, and local programming—Design Hotels suits owners who prioritize independent character and design credibility over flag-standardization.

whyValueStrongest.label: Why Value Is Strongest in These Scenarios
bullets: Design Hotels fits owners of distinctive independent hotels who want curated global recognition without a rigid chain prototype.
Member hotels retain independent ownership and operating identity while accessing collection credibility and selective Marriott Bonvoy participation where applicable.
Curation emphasizes design, architecture, culture, and local storytelling—not standardized chain rollouts.
Owners should compare affiliation value against other Marriott soft-collection paths (e.g., Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio) based on asset character and control preferences.
Dealality frames this as an affiliation / curation platform—not a conventional chain-flag conversion.
Curated collection of independent, design-forward member hotels—each with distinct character and local identity.
Emphasis on architecture, interior design, cultural programming, and authentic place-making.
Member hotels are independently owned and operated
Design Hotels provides curation, platform affiliation, and collection positioning.
Selective participation in Marriott Bonvoy where property-level agreements support it—benefits and participation may vary by member hotel.
Collection affiliation can support discovery through Marriott channels without implying a single uniform commercial package for every property.
Owners should diligence distribution participation, recognition mechanics, and commercial fit during affiliation evaluation.
Public materials describe a global member directory and collection positioning—not property-level performance representations.

bestAt.label: What This Brand Is Best At

cards.title: Design-Led Independent Identity
cards.body: Design-Led Independent Identity: Preserving architectural narrative, local culture, and independent operating character while joining a globally recognized design collection.

cards.title: Curation & Collection Credibility
cards.body: Curation & Collection Credibility: Global collection context and member-hotel curation standards that signal quality to guests, operators, and capital partners without prototype homogenization.

cards.title: Affiliation Without Franchise Prototype
cards.body: Affiliation Without Franchise Prototype: Affiliation path for owners who reject rigid chain prototypes but want platform affiliation, selective Bonvoy participation, and Marriott ecosystem context where supported.

ownerValueSnapshot.label: Owner Value Snapshot
outcomes: For owners of one-of-a-kind boutique assets seeking affiliation without a rigid chain prototype—peer to Autograph Collection and Tribute Portfolio within Marriott's soft-collection tier.
experience: acquired via Starwood and now fully owned by Marriott International. Member hotels remain independently owned and operated.

featuredApplication.label: Featured Application / Conversion Example
featuredApplication.body: Curated collection of 300+ independent, design-forward member hotels—each with distinct character, now Marriott-owned with selective Bonvoy participation.

portfolioContext.label: Portfolio Context
portfolioContext.title: Design Hotels — Marriott Soft-Collection Affiliation
portfolioContext.body: Within Marriott International's portfolio spectrum, Design Hotels sits as a design-led independent collection—alongside Autograph Collection and Tribute Portfolio—emphasizing curation over standardized franchise conversion.
portfolioContext.referencePattern: Marriott owner-planning ladder with soft-collection sibling labels (Autograph Collection, Design Hotels, etc.)

cards.title: Design-Led Independent Affiliation
cards.body: Owners of architecturally distinctive independents seeking global collection recognition—evaluate curation standards, owner control, and selective Bonvoy participation without surrendering local identity.

cards.title: Boutique Repositioning With Integrity
cards.body: Repositioned boutique or lifestyle assets where design narrative and guest experience authenticity are central—owners assess membership criteria and design review expectations during diligence.

cards.title: Urban Cultural Destination
cards.body: Urban hotels anchored in neighborhood culture, art, and local programming—Design Hotels suits owners prioritizing independent character over flag standardization.

cards.title: Third-Party Operator–Led
cards.body: Assets run by experienced lifestyle or design-led operators—affiliation supports owner and operator teams who need collection credibility while preserving property-specific F&B and design decisions.

phases.title: Evaluate — Affiliation Fit
phases.body: Confirm asset character, design narrative, operating model, and owner objectives align with a curated collection—not a franchise conversion path.

phases.title: Diligence — Membership Criteria
phases.body: Review public membership materials; confirm participation criteria, design expectations, distribution mechanics, and agreement structure with brand/platform representatives.

phases.title: Onboarding — Design & Brand Standards
phases.body: Plan for design review, property storytelling, and collection integration while preserving independent operating identity.

phases.title: Operate — Independent Character
phases.body: Maintain local programming, design integrity, and guest experience differentiation within collection affiliation guardrails.

phases.title: Distribute — Platform Participation
phases.body: Confirm Bonvoy and distribution participation scope per property agreement—benefits may vary by participating member hotel.

phases.title: Review — Ongoing Alignment
phases.body: Periodically reassess collection fit, design evolution, and affiliation value as markets and owner strategy change.

keyWatchouts.label: Key Watchouts
bullets: Do not assume uniform Bonvoy benefits or distribution participation across all member hotels.
Curation and design review expectations may limit rapid prototype-style conversions.
Public collection materials are not property-level performance representations.
Agreement structure, participation costs, and standards should be confirmed directly—not inferred from this Explorer view.

standardsDetail.intro: Public Design Hotels materials describe a curated member collection—not a published owner participation checklist. Owners should confirm participation criteria, design review, distribution requirements, brand standards, agreement structure, and operating implications directly with the brand platform.

conversionTransitions.label: Conversion & Sister-Flag Transitions
conversionTransitions.body: Affiliation transitions should preserve design integrity and independent character. Owners comparing Marriott soft-collection paths should assess curation fit—not assume franchise-style conversion economics.

dealalityInsight.label: Dealality Insight
dealalityInsight.body: Design Hotels is best understood as a design-led independent hotel collection with Marriott affiliation context—not a franchise soft brand. Owners of distinctive boutique and lifestyle assets should evaluate curation fit, operating autonomy, selective Bonvoy participation, and agreement economics against Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio, and independent paths.
